description: Chief Secretariat - Southern Province - Entertainment Tax Ordinance Imaduwa Pradeshiya Sabhawa
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the imposition and administration of an entertainment tax by a local government authority (Imaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha) under specific ordinances and acts. It establishes a regulatory framework for tax collection (15% on entertainment activities) and specifies compliance requirements, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure change or other specialized category.
